after_snippet:
import click

# In 8.4.0, Parameter is abstract and cannot be instantiated
# Use a concrete subclass instead
param = click.Option(['-t', '--test'])
assert param is not None
before_snippet:
import click

# In 8.3.3, Parameter could be instantiated directly
param = click.core.Parameter(param_decls=['--test'])
assert param is not None
title: Parameter is now an abstract base class and cannot be instantiated directly
